guard: Candidates only; read sources and verify applicability; empty does not establish absence.

results.summary: When the claim is about what the running host does (status logged, log level, response for an aborted request), test it through the real composed pipeline; a middleware tested in isolation can be correct while another layer in the real order still produces the old behaviour.
results.need_to_read: 讀取 host-level 測試的具體驗證方式，確認真實 middleware 組合順序、其他層的狀態與日誌處理，以及實際請求情境如何納入測試。
